`false`: do nothing, unsuccessfully.

## Synopsis

<strong>false</strong>

## Description

<strong>false</strong> does nothing and exits with a status of 1. Arguments are ignored.

The shell has <strong>false</strong> built in as well; this program is what runs when it is called by path (<strong>/bin/false</strong>) or from another program.

## Exit status

Always 1.

## See also

<strong>true</strong>(1), <strong>sh</strong>(1)
